description: Defines the TemplateRadioEnum class, a PHP class extending TemplateEnum, for rendering and handling radio button enum fields in SuiteCRM. Includes methods for generating HTML, field definitions, search, and detail views.

classes.name: TemplateRadioEnum
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering radio button enum fields in SuiteCRM, extending TemplateEnum with methods for HTML generation, field definitions, and view rendering.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns the HTML snippet for editing the field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including database type and separator.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares data for the edit template, including radio options.

methods.name: generateRadioButtons
methods.description: Generates HTML radio button inputs based on options and current value.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Prepares data for search template with radio options.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns display value for the detail view based on current bean data.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns default database value, empty string in this implementation.
